proposals.evidence: DEDR 1208 full article opens “1208 Kol. katk- (katakt-) to strike down (man), break down (tree). Nk. (Ch.) katuk-/ katk- to cut with axe. Pa. katt- to cut down (tree),…”; its Ga. (Oll.) passage gives “Ga. (Oll.) kat- to cut, sacrifice.”. The full article gives Ollari kat- “cut, sacrifice”; no separate sacrificial donor is proposed.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1281 full article opens “1281 Ta. karukkāy young and immature fruit. Ma. karikku an unripe coconut. Ka. (Gowda) kərki tender, unripe fruit. Tu. gargayi half-ripe,…”; its Ga. (Oll.) passage gives “Ga. (Oll.) karke unripe mango; (S.) karke mango. Cf. 1279 Ta. karu . DED(S) 1076.”. The primary Ga. (Oll.) sense is “unripe mango”; the same source form also occurs as a month name and that record is held.
